literal_meaning: ছিটকে পড়া (scattering or splashing and falling)
figurative_meaning_en: To go to distant regions or scatter to far-off places
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাকরির খোঁজে সবাই চারিদিকে ছিটকে পড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone is scattering to all directions in search of jobs.
The village youths are dispersing to the cities.
note: The idiom reflects patterns of rural-urban migration in Bengali society.
